L4_constrained_composite.note: rho_chi is the spectral radius of the chi -> chi block of the K-layer composite Jacobian, i.e. the quantity whose being < 1 is the hypothesis of Cor. fidelity; M_J = sup_{m in [1, 2]} ||J^m|| is the transient factor that the geometric bound rho^m omits.  Float64 because the CG contrast solve amplifies directional derivatives by ~1/lambda_min.

L4_unconstrained_composite.note: rho_chi is the spectral radius of the chi -> chi block of the K-layer composite Jacobian, i.e. the quantity whose being < 1 is the hypothesis of Cor. fidelity; M_J = sup_{m in [1, 2]} ||J^m|| is the transient factor that the geometric bound rho^m omits.  Float64 because the CG contrast solve amplifies directional derivatives by ~1/lambda_min.

L5_non_normality.note: rho^m <= ||J^m|| <= kappa_2(V) rho^m; the observed gap sigma_max/rho is the price of reading a spectral radius as a contraction rate on a non-normal layer.
